notices.desc.staff: Plain text on officers' Home until it runs out: every department or the ones you pick. You can also end any department's notice here.
notices.off: Staff notices are switched off in Settings (Notices). Running notices can still be ended.
notices.alert_mode.toast: On-duty officers also get a toast.
notices.alert_mode.sound: On-duty officers also get a toast with a tone.
err.notice_kind: That kind of notice does not exist. Refresh the screen and try again.
err.notice_kind_off: Staff notices are switched off. Switch them on in Settings (Notices) first.
err.notice_unknown: That notice is not running any more. Refresh the list.
